GPU image-generation server with ComfyUI, its built-in manager, and model-download tooling baked in
Clones ComfyUI at the pinned COMFYUI_REF tag into the image-owned
/opt/comfyui, and keeps every mutable thing in the comfyui volume at
~/ComfyUI through ComfyUI's own --base-directory. The built-in manager
is enabled (--enable-manager); there is no ComfyUI-Manager custom-node
clone. aria2 and git-lfs fetch the checkpoint and the model set on
first boot. A supervisord service runs /opt/comfyui/start-comfyui.sh,
which seeds the state tree, writes the model-set manifest and launches
the fetch before it execs main.py --listen 0.0.0.0 --port 8188. Each
piece is verifiable: the pinned app clone, the model dirs, the
download-tooling packages, and the live /system_stats API on port 8188.

## Services

- `comfyui`
